title: Billionaire CEO: How to Get 1M Downloads in 6 Months @replit
description:
Produced by  @atomik-growth 

What does it actually take to build an app that reaches 1 million downloads?

In this conversation, Replit CEO Amjad Masad shares a practical framework for building products in the AI era.

His advice isn't to chase dozens of features or spend years perfecting code. Instead, he argues that the most valuable skill today is idea generation.

As AI dramatically reduces the cost and time required to build software, the biggest competitive advantage becomes finding unique ideas, designing a simple user experience, shipping an MVP quickly, and getting real user feedback.

The framework:

• Start with a unique idea connected to a growing trend.
• Clearly define the core user experience.
• Focus on the smallest product that delivers value fast.
• Test it with real users.
• Iterate based on feedback.

Whether you're building an AI startup, launching your first app, or learning entrepreneurship, these principles can help you build products people actually want.

If you're interested in AI, startups, SaaS, entrepreneurship, app development, and founder mindset, subscribe for more conversations from the world's top founders and CEOs.

💬 Question:
If you had six months to build one app, what problem would you solve?
